name: stadium_card_stunt
promptTemplate: Grand stadium card stunt displaying {{motif}} under {{stadium_lighting}} lights with {{wave_style}} wave ripple, {{flip_speed}} card flip rate, and {{flashbulbs}} crowd flashbulbs.

motif.hint: Change the giant mosaic formed by thousands of cards

wave_style.hint: Set ripple pattern propagating across the stands

flip_speed.hint: Card flip rate and ripple propagation speed

flashbulbs.hint: Sparks spectator camera flashes in the crowd on beats

listing.blurb: Tiers of stadium seats hold flipping colored cards that synchronize into giant arena mosaics and ripples of Mexican waves beneath floodlit rafters.
listing.prompt: A stadium card stunt: tiers of seats seen from across the pitch, each seat a coloured card, flipping in waves to form a giant image -- a flag, a face, a rising sun -- then a Mexican wave running round the stands. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
